content.text:
I'd open an account at פסגות and buy the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund. The page marks that pair as "הזול" (the cheapest). With the page's example of 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years at 7%, it says I'd end up with about 86,500 ₪. I'm fairly sure about the account and the fund, but not about the final number. What decided it was the big box at the top: "הבחירה שלכם · ★ הזול — 86,492 ₪".

One catch: I've never heard of ילין לפידות. Right next to it is אלטשולר שחם, a name I know from ads, and it's only "−43 ₪" less over 10 years. So I'd probably take Altshuler and not care about the 43 ₪.

**What confused me about the number**
- The page put my deposits at "70,000 ₪". At 7% a year for 10 years I'd expect about 70% more, around 119,000 ₪. The page says 86,492. I don't get why it's so low.
- Under the number it says "בכסף של היום" and "אחרי דמי ניהול ומס". I think that means after fees and tax, in today's prices. I still don't really get it.
- The page's amount is 10,000 ₪. I have 30,000, so for me it should be more. I didn't change the field, so I don't know my real figure.

**Order I looked**
1. **Top of the page.** Heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד" — right away, this is for me. Pressed S&P 500. Then the four fields: 10,000 now, 500 a month, 10 years, 7%. Then the big numbers: 70,000 deposited, 86,492 for the cheapest pair, 86,449 for the runner-up.
2. **Accounts list on the right.** פסגות first at 86,492, then לאומי 83,396, הבינלאומי 82,371, then down to מיטב at 63,507. On the far left of each row there's a small extra number (1,057, 4,541, 26,817...). I'm not sure what those are, maybe what the account costs.
3. **Fund list on the left.** Rows marked "−213", "−447", "−3,671" against my choice. Lots of tags in different colours that I didn't read. Further down, foreign ones (iShares, Vanguard) with "אין מחיר כאן", so I skipped them. The one at the bottom said "בין +2,212 ל־−23,766 ₪", and a range like that scared me off.
4. **Chart of what changes the result.** I only caught "אם תגדילו כל מספר ב־20%, הכי ישנה מספר השנים: 19,116 ₪ יותר" — staying longer matters most.
5. **Dollar section.** Bar charts and a table of years — I got bored and stopped there. I didn't look at screens 8–10.

**What I skipped**
- The coloured cost breakdown bar and its legend at the top of screen 2
- The explanation text under the fund list
- The whole "עם נטרול מט"ח או בלי" section
- Everything after the year table

**Words I didn't get**
- דמי משמרת, נאמן, צוברת, מחלקת דיבידנד
- עסקת החלף, נטרול מט"ח, מנוטרלת מט"ח
- (4D) and (4A) in the fund names
- "מכפיל", טופס W-8BEN, "לא בחישוב"
- "עוד לא נאסף", "אין שנה מלאה"
- The 1,057 under פסגות — I don't know what it is

**What I'd change**
- Explain right next to 86,492 why it isn't about 119,000
- Fewer tags on each fund
- Make the fund list a lot shorter
- Show my own amount up front, not 10,000
